```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Question 1

library(deSolve)

############################################################
# FUNCTION: run_sir_model
# PURPOSE: Solve deterministic SIR model with deSolve
# INPUTS:
#   beta, gamma : transmission & recovery rates
#   N           : total population
#   S0, I0, R0  : initial conditions
#   t_start     : start time
#   t_end       : end time
#   dt          : timestep
# OUTPUT:
#   data.frame with columns: time, S, I, R
############################################################

run_sir_model <- function(
  beta    = 0.1,
  gamma   = 0.1,
  N       = 1000,
  S0      = 999,
  I0      = 1,
  R0      = 0,
  t_start = 0,
  t_end   = 160,
  dt      = 1
) {

  init  <- c(S = S0, I = I0, R = R0)
  times <- seq(t_start, t_end, by = dt)

  sir_equations <- function(time, state, parameters) {
    with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
      dS <- -beta * S * I / N
      dI <-  beta * S * I / N - gamma * I
      dR <-  gamma * I
      list(c(dS, dI, dR))
    })
  }

  out <- ode(
    y     = init,
    times = times,
    func  = sir_equations,
    parms = c(beta = beta, gamma = gamma, N = N)
  )

  as.data.frame(out)
}
############################################################################
# END FUNCTION

#create parameter vectors
beta_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = 0.5, by = 0.01)
gamma_vec <- seq(from = 0, to = 0.5, by = 0.01)

sir_sweep <- function(beta_vec, gamma_vec){

  # row indexing variable
  counter <- 1

  # create storage dataframe
  dfLength <- length(beta_vec)*length(gamma_vec) # how long is DF
  max_infected <- rep(NA, dfLength)
  beta_out <- rep(NA, dfLength)
  gamma_out <- rep(NA, dfLength)
  

  # turn vecs into df
  storageDF <- data.frame(max_infected, beta_out, gamma_out)


  # enter our loops
  for (i in seq_along(beta_vec)){ # rows
    for (j in seq_along(gamma_vec)){ # cols

      # run sir model
      tmp_df <- run_sir_model(beta = beta_vec[i], gamma = gamma_vec[j])

      # store data in dataframe
      storageDF$max_infected[counter] <- max(tmp_df$I)
      storageDF$beta_out[counter] <- beta_vec[i] # value for r stored
      storageDF$gamma_out[counter] <- gamma_vec[j] # value for k stored

      counter <- counter + 1 # increase counter
    }
  }
  return(storageDF)
}

# run sir param sweep
df <- sir_sweep(beta_vec = beta_vec , gamma_vec = gamma_vec)

head(df)


# Question 2

############################################################
# FUNCTION: heat_map
# PURPOSE: Makes heat map from SIR model
# INPUTS:
    # df = SIR dataframe
# OUTPUT:
#   heat map plot: beta_out, gamma_out, max_infected
############################################################
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
heat_map <- function(df){
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = beta_out, y = gamma_out, fill = max_infected, )) +
  geom_tile() + xlab("Beta") + ylab("Gamma") + labs(fill = "Max Infected") + scale_fill_viridis() + theme_bw()
}
heat_map(df)
```
